messages:
Alex: Heads up — console toggle for soft-fallback (v1->v2) fired this morning and we got an unexpected quota spike from tenant-acme :warning:
Sam: ugh, saw the alert. any logs or traces? :eyes:
Alex: pasted the tail of the proxy logs:```2026-03-20T09:12:02Z proxy route=soft-fallback tenant=acme request_id=abc123 fallback=v2 cost_tokens=12500``` there are repeated retries from the client after 429s
Chen: is the fallback looped through the quota-aware router or the legacy router?
Alex: looks like legacy path — the console toggle created a route that points at v2 but doesn't opt into the quota-shim. so requests count twice (v1 + v2) for a window
Maria: that explains the billing ping. We should flip the console toggle to a circuit-breaker mode instead of immediate redirect. Can we hotfix?
Sam: quick mitigation: disable fallback for tenant-acme in the console and add a deny rule until we patch. I can do that now if ppl agree.
Chen: agree. Also we need a short-term routing change: ensure any fallback route sets header `X-Quota-Handled: true` so the router dedupes counting. Patch sketch:```yaml
routing:
  fallback:
    dedupe_quota: true
    quota_header: X-Quota-Handled
```
Alex: thanks. I'll open a follow-up RFC to require dedupe_quota default=true for all soft-fallbacks.
Maria: UX note: console toggle language needs to warn explicitly "may double-count tokens until dedupe is enabled". I'll update the copy + add a tooltip.
Sam: done — disabled acme fallback and added an incident note in the tenant dashboard.
deploy-bot: deploy accepted by Sam in staging at 09:18Z — job #4312
Alex: next steps: (1) prod hotfix to set quota header on fallback routes (Sam/Chen), (2) console copy + tooltip (Maria), (3) RFC for default dedupe and telemetry (Alex). I'll create tasks. :thumbsup:
Chen: i'll prepare a small patch and unit tests for the router check. targeting a canary in the EU region first.
Sam: ping me for the prod rollout window — i'll schedule the downtime-free slot.
Maria: I'll coordinate with docs for the admin-facing changelog.
Alex: great — let's sync in the 30-min standup if anything blocks. thanks all. :sos:
